name: yokoten
description: Rules, guards and skills for AI coding agents: the tool-call guard, doctor at the start of each session, and the yokoten skills and agents.

hooks.command: node --max-old-space-size=256 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/yokoten.ts" hook --commands-only; code=$?; [ $code -eq 0 ] || [ $code -eq 2 ] || { echo "yokoten's guard failed (exit $code), so the command is refused; run \`yokoten doctor\`" >&2; code=2; }; exit $code
